professionalSummary.text: Energy Analytics Analyst with three years of experience analyzing metered energy data for 24 commercial buildings under team procedures, identifying savings measures with expected savings, and preparing monthly performance reports for landlords under energy performance contracts.
professionalSummary.witness: Energy analytics analyst at a building services company for three years, analysing the metered energy data of twenty-four commercial buildings under the team's analysis procedure and identifying savings measures with their expected savings. Prepared the monthly performance report for each landlord under the energy performance contracts, with the reports accepted by the landlords' facilities managers.

experienceHighlights.text: Monitored contracted savings against baseline, raised two shortfalls to account director, and documented in savings register.
experienceHighlights.witness: Monitored the contracted savings against the baseline each month and raised two shortfalls to the account director concerned, recorded in the savings register.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated measure proposals with site engineers through measure log, with approvals and commitments staying with account director, and documented analysis ownership in log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated the measure proposals with the site engineers through the measure log; the measure approvals and the contract commitments were the account director's, recorded on each proposal, and the log records which analyses were mine.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented limitations and hand-over conditions for each measure proposal in collaboration with site engineers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each measure proposal for the site engineers.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided monthly performance reports, measure proposals with approval records, savings register extracts, and energy data platform references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one monthly performance report, two measure proposals with their approval records and the savings register extract for one quarter, with the energy data platform references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Energy data analysis, performance reporting, savings monitoring, measure coordination, documentation of limitations and hand-over conditions.
skills.witness: Energy analytics analyst at a building services company for three years, analysing the metered energy data of twenty-four commercial buildings under the team's analysis procedure and identifying savings measures with their expected savings. Prepared the monthly performance report for each landlord under the energy performance contracts, with the reports accepted by the landlords' facilities managers. Monitored the contracted savings against the baseline each month and raised two shortfalls to the account director concerned, recorded in the savings register. Coordinated the measure proposals with the site engineers through the measure log; the measure approvals and the contract commitments were the account director's, recorded on each proposal, and the log records which analyses were mine. Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each measure proposal for the site engineers.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in analyzing energy data, preparing reports, monitoring savings, coordinating measures, and documenting limitations, but do not establish specific technical tools used, the exact nature of the 'savings register', or the candidate's direct interaction with landlords beyond report acceptance.
